spark_open.description: The creature is shown in strict right-facing profile standing on a flat light surface against a plain off-white background. It has the head and hooked beak of a large raptor and the heavy, shaggy-coated body and thick legs of a mammal, standing upright on two legs. The upper back, shoulders and outer thighs are covered in dense, shaggy medium-brown fur-like hair, while the neck, chest, lower belly, wings and tail show layered feathers in shades of tan, cream, light brown and dark brown. A pair of folded wings lies along the sides of the body with dark brown flight feathers visible along the lower edge beneath the shaggy covering. The head is feathered with a small tufted crest on the crown, a yellow cere at the base of a dark gray hooked beak, and a yellow-brown eye. The legs are thick and heavily furred down to large scaly yellow feet that end in long black talons. A long, broad, feathered tail extends behind the body.
